latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker Sora 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate 1080p AI videos from text prompts or uploaded files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, PNG, up to 200MB)
- Automatic setup with free token generation and cloud GPU rendering; no local installation needed
- Supports exporting in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, MKV, JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC)
- Simple workflows: upload content, generate or edit with text commands, and download final videos
- Includes session management, credit tracking, and real-time status updates for smooth video creation
